nc.description: A light gray 3D rendering shows a central sphere encased within a geometric structure of segmented rings and connecting bars against a white background.
A 3D rendering shows a straight faceted shaft connected to a twisted faceted shaft by a multi-part circular coupling.
A static structure composed of smooth, light grey, intersecting geometric blocks is displayed against a plain white background.
A grey mechanical arm suspends a large, faceted object directly above a smaller white block.
A symmetrical arrangement of white mechanical parts surrounds a central, open capsule containing gears.

vc.description: A light grey mechanical framework with padded clamps secures a smooth white cylinder.
A close-up shows a mechanical assembly featuring a threaded rod, a toothed wheel, and a textured band secured by a knurled knob.
A close-up view displays a grey mechanical joint assembly consisting of two angled struts connected to a central hinge mechanism resting on padded base sections.
A robotic hand with multiple articulated fingers grips the end of a geared mechanical arm, while a broken piece of casing falls below them.
A central mechanical assembly is surrounded by a symmetrical, radial arrangement of hardware components including bolts, gears, washers, and plates.
